title: Depth Chart Facts
description: Source-observed team depth-chart placement. Preserve source ordering and role labels rather than normalizing away distinctions. ONE ROW PER PLAYER PER CLUB PER SEASON: a player must never appear twice. A return job is carried as a `role` on the player's single row, not as a second row in a KR/PR position group -- decided 2026-08-28, see BL-038. The alternative put the same man on the board twice and forced every consumer to decide whether to sum him.

role.description: Source role label such as X, Z, SLOT, RB, 3DRB, TE, LWR, SWR, RWR -- and KR or PR where the source states a return job. The return job lives HERE rather than in `position_group`, so that a returner occupies one row and one roster identity. A returner who appears on no offensive chart still takes exactly one row, carrying his return role; he is not duplicated and he is not omitted.

package.description: Optional personnel/package context when the source distinguishes it.
